name: Tumblr
label: Tumblr API v2 — NPF posts, blog info, dashboard
description: Official Tumblr API v2 at https://api.tumblr.com/v2. OfficialApiNode: POST /blog/{blog_identifier}/posts, GET /blog/{blog_identifier}/posts/{post_id}, GET /blog/{blog_identifier}/info, GET /user/dashboard. Auth is StudioQuack secret access_token (Bearer). No trigger — Tumblr documents no webhook API. Customer owns the Tumblr app. Never log access_token.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT: post_create | post_get | blog_info | user_dashboard.

schema.label: blog_identifier
schema.description: Path {blog_identifier}: hostname or UUID. Required for post_create, post_get, blog_info.

schema.label: content
schema.description: Official Tumblr Neue Post Format content blocks (list of {type, text, …}). Required on post_create. Example: [{"type":"text","text":"Hello"}]. https://www.tumblr.com/docs/en/api/v2#posts--create-a-new-blog-post-neue-post-format

schema.label: tags
schema.description: Comma-separated tags for post_create. Example: news,update.

schema.label: state
schema.description: post_create state. EXACT: published | draft | queue | private. Example: published.

schema.label: offset
schema.description: user_dashboard offset. Prefer before/after beyond the documented offset max.

schema.label: type
schema.description: Dashboard post type filter. user_dashboard. EXACT: text | quote | link | answer | video | audio | photo | chat.

schema.label: since_id
schema.description: Dashboard: return posts after this id. user_dashboard.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (provider JSON including meta). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Exact 'ok' on HTTP 2xx. Tumblr may still put a non-200 meta.status in data.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider JSON (meta, blog, post, or posts).

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: post_create | post_get | blog_info | user_dashboard.

configurationParameters.label: Access token
configurationParameters.description: Tumblr OAuth 2 access token (StudioQuack secret). Sent as Authorization: Bearer. Never log or place on INPUT. Empty → no HTTP.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 → 25. Keep below the daemon invoke budget.
